name: CodeFuse-DeBench
description: CodeFuse-DeBench is an automated benchmark framework for evaluating decompiled binaries across three stages: (1) Readability: Evaluates the readability of decompiled code Syntactic Correctness. (2) Recompilation: Tests whether decompiled code can be successfully recompiled. (3) Functionality: Verifies the functional correctness of decompiled code.
